title: Workpaper narrative
description: The prose summary of a run: what was processed, what was adjusted, what remains open, what a reviewer should look at first. Four lists of sentences and nothing else. There is no numeric field, no total and no conclusion: a figure enters the prose only by being rendered from a locked value, and the numeric lock checks the prose against the locked set before release. Written upstream of the Deliverable QC Gate, so nothing here escapes verification.
